04 / Behind the Blue Jays

Meet Coach Nic

Assistant General Manager · Coach · Instructor

Nic

Nic is the Assistant General Manager. He is the head coach of our 11u and 17u Blue jays teams. He is a full time instructor at the facility and also instructs our Sub 2 and Arm Care Programs. He also runs all camps. And does social media. Dude lives here.

Nic grew up in Atlanta and attended St Pius X Catholic High School. In his high school years, Nic played for the Ninth inning Royals program and got the privilege of playing for Wes Borden. His college years were as a catcher at Montreat College, and recently graduated from Kennesaw State University with a Bachelor of Science in Sports Management.

Off the field, Nic has two miniature wiener dogs at home named Hennessy and Jaeger Bomb. He enjoys long walks on the beach, and spending far too much time and money being incredibly bad at golf. When you see Nic around the facility don’t forget to say hello and offer him some new swing thoughts for his golf game!
